title: Mid-Term Commitment Increase Allowance and Fee — Operating Lines of Credit
content:
During a term, the commitment on most Operating Lines of Credit may be raised up to a set share of the commitment in force, against a fee on the amount of the increase.

## Terms

- **Largest mid-term increase**: the largest mid-term commitment increase that may be requested, as a percentage of the commitment in force; 0 means no mid-term increase.
- **Commitment increase fee**: the fee on the amount of an approved mid-term commitment increase, in percent.

## Schedule

| Product | Largest mid-term increase (% of commitment in force) | Commitment increase fee (% of the increase) |
|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 20 | 0 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 25 | 0.25 |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 0 (no mid-term increase) | 0 |
| Revolving Operating Line | 25 | 0.25 |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 25 | 0.20 (0.2) |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 30 | 0.15 |

## Points of reading

- The Seasonal Operating Loan takes no mid-term increase; the StartRight Operating Line takes one free of any increase fee.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on an ExpressLine Operating Credit with a commitment in force of USD 200,000, 25% is an increase of up to USD 50,000; a USD 50,000 increase carries a fee of 0.25% of USD 50,000, that is USD 125.00.
